method: Country-specific piecewise histories combining long institutional tradition with temporally gated participation, competition and player-pathway evidence.
evidence_rules: Portugal broad practitioner estimates remain distinct from registered membership.
Tennis Ireland all-island evidence is explicitly partial/overbroad for Earth IRL and never represented as Republic-only measurement.
Modern junior/performance programmes are not backcast before their dates.
Competition quality uses competition structures and pathways, not direct star-player peak conversion.
No held-out validation ranking is used for tuning.
